messages:
maria: Quick idea — prototype for Console: a compact per-route card that surfaces the pinned model, recent token burn, p50 latency, and a small sparkline for errors. goal is one-line glanceability for on-call and PMs.

sam: +1 on glanceability. can we make the pinned model editable inline? that would let SREs switch fallback fast.

joel: inline edit is fine, but note quota routing interacts. if a route is under a quota cap we should show a subtle red badge and a tooltip explaining fallback policy. no one should be surprised when request routing changes.

liz: agree. also telemetry sample rates need to be surfaced per-route. if samples are 1% the error sparkline will be noisy. suggest a tiny icon with sample rate on hover.

maria: good call. design mock: `[{route: "/api/chat", model: "redwood-v1", tokens_24h: 1.2M, p50: 85ms, err_rate: 0.4%, sample_rate: 0.5%}]` — wondering about saved-query coupling: should a saved view pin the model or leave model selection as an independent control?

ana: (typo) ana: my vote: saved views should pin the filters (route + time + metric set) but not force model pin. forcing model in a saved view caused confusion last sprint with experiment rollouts.

sam: +1 to not force model pin. but add a checkbox in save dialog: "also pin model" for workflows that need reproducibility.

joel: operationally we need audit trails when model pin changes. if SRE flips a pin during an incident, log it with user and a link to the route snapshot. Console already has an event stream — can we reuse?

maria: yes we can reuse event stream. Deploy-bot: could you add a small event type `route.model.pin`?

deploy-bot: noted. created ticket INF-4392 and will emit `route.model.pin` with fields: user, route_id, old_model, new_model, timestamp. :white_check_mark:

liz: rollout UX question — when a model rollout is happening (canary -> 50% -> 100%), Console cards should show a split pill with top 2 models and percentages, not just a single pinned model (since routing is probabilistic).

maria: yes, display primary + secondary with percent. also add tiny "fallbacks" row if there are configured fallback tiers (e.g., small-latency variant).

ana: telemetry caveat: when routing is split, metrics should be model-tagged. otherwise p50 is meaningless. we'll need to add model dimension to the route telemetry index.

joel: agreed. adding model tag will increase storage but we can sample at model granularity only when split exists. lazy enable.

sam: UX thought — saved queries list should indicate when the underlying route telemetry schema changed (e.g., model dimension added or sample rate changed) with a small yellow warning: "View may be partial — telemetry schema changed since save".

maria: love that. implementation plan: 1) add compact card design + hover details, 2) saved view option checkbox "pin model", 3) event for model pin changes, 4) telemetry model-dimension toggles, 5) warnings on saved queries when schema mismatches.

liz: can we do a lightweight AB: 50% of users see the compact card, 50% see current layout. measure adoption + time-to-root-cause on incident.

maria: yep. we'll wire an experiment flag in Console and capture these metrics. sam, can you own the API contract for pin toggle + saved view flag?

sam: I can. I'll draft a minimal PATCH /api/routes/{id}/view to accept `{ "pin_model": true|false }` and a separate POST /api/audit/events for the model.pin if missing. will post the spec here.

maria: thanks. joel, ana — can you estimate telemetry infra work (model-dim tagging + sampling when split)?

joel: estimate 3 dev-days for core tagging and 2 ops-days for storage + backfill policy. could be lower if we lazy-enable only on split routes.

ana: +1 to lazy-enable; reduces blast radius.

maria: great. i'll put a short RFC in #product-docs and attach mock screenshots. putting INF-4392 on the board. thanks all! :rocket:
